company.name: Maitai
company.shortDescription: Maitai is a reliable and self-improving enterprise AI, ready to enhance the business efficiency.
company.description: Maitai solves LLM output reliability with real-time autocorrections, then automatically builds self-improving, application-specific models. The result is a fully managed model stack through a simple integration, with inference that passively gets better, faster, and cheaper over time.

productsAndServices.description: Custom large language models tailored to specific enterprise applications, improving accuracy and performance over time through continuous learning from production data.
productsAndServices.name: Enterprise-grade Large Language Models (LLMs)

productsAndServices.description: A platform providing fast and efficient AI model inference by leveraging partnerships with advanced hardware providers to minimize latency and maximize throughput.
productsAndServices.name: Low-latency AI Inference Platform

productsAndServices.description: A system that detects and corrects faults in AI model outputs in real-time, applying application-specific guardrails to ensure output quality and consistency.
productsAndServices.name: LLM Autocorrection and Output Guardrails

productsAndServices.description: A hosting service that allows customers to deploy their own LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) models on dedicated high-performance hardware without large upfront investments.
productsAndServices.name: Bring Your Own LoRA Hosting Service

productsAndServices.description: Services facilitating easy integration of Maitai’s AI solutions into existing workflows, including API access, key management, and enterprise-grade support.
productsAndServices.name: Enterprise AI Integration and Support Services
